scope: Explicit field-only inline format intent in Rust, local Wasm and shared V1/V2 SDK controls. Preserves observed mixed Link properties without changing existing persisted format operations or concurrent conflict policy.

contracts.core: RichFormatPropertyPatch has its own named documented action file. A complete typed template supplies a nonempty unique list of existing fields. RichFormatChange::Patch merges only those fields into every selected existing format, retaining omitted properties and unrelated kinds. Missing formats reject, never skip or guess. Final local schema/limits admission and exact node-patch inverses remain unchanged.
contracts.localBoundary: Only the separate changeInlineFormats command accepts patch, formatsJson and properties. Original setInlineFormat remains set/remove-only. Template JSON uses the existing strict codec. Duplicate kinds/fields, invalid values/ranges and late failures publish no content, selection or history. The original inlineControlsVersion remains 1; separate inlinePropertyPatchesVersion is 1, surfaced as supportsInlinePropertyPatches.
contracts.sharedBoundary: patch_inline_format_properties checks the exact opaque observation before decoding. The native planner inspects current admitted source runs and lowers changed/coalesced results to existing Command::SetFormat annotations in one guarded author-local group. A true no-op retains the checkpoint, observation and Redo branch. No patch request is persisted as a journal or network command.
contracts.limits: Shared input remains bounded to 64 KiB, unique target blocks and the original 64-command group ceiling after coalescing. Oversized heterogeneous patches fail atomically; no automatic batching or limit widening. Local action limits remain unchanged.
contracts.toolbar: Leave mixed Link URL or target blank to preserve each existing value for that field. At least one field is required, and every selected character must already be linked for a partial patch. Supplying both fields uses the original complete set; Unlink removes links. Dirty draft revision guards and the credential-free absolute HTTP(S) URL policy are unchanged. Existing color/size commands already preserve unrelated format kinds.
contracts.concurrency: Observed omitted properties survive authoring. Concurrent changes to different properties of one format are not independently merged registers: the original complete-format causal policy still selects a complete value. Selective Undo removes the author's owned annotations, retaining foreign text and unrelated formats. A different policy requires a separately versioned replication design.
contracts.compatibility: Original factories/defaults and ABI descriptors retain their meanings. Model 11/journal 12 and explicit model 12/journal 13 are unchanged. Older matching owners report no patch capability and reject without a JS fallback. Application runtime stays five JS exports and has 54 raw Wasm exports, including the additive guarded method. No dependency or vendor edit.

nativeChecks.coverage: Mixed URL/target values, Unicode scalar ranges, complete template/field admission, original single-command rejection, exact future history after recovery, peer text/format retention, stale/no-op guards and atomic 64-command rejection/coalescing. Research executes the canonical test via a facade shim, not copied contracts.
nativeChecks.note: No complete research or --all-features qualification is claimed. The existing dependency HasIdSpan warning is unchanged; first-party checks are strict and vendor sources are untouched.

newPatchesWithOldPeer.coverage: Older peer receives the lowered format operations, retains offline foreign text, and restores the newer journal for byte-exact future Undo/Redo.

configurations: Full React/shared Node initialization, SSR and package-root declarations

initialRun.failure: Existing WebKit cancelled durable mount returned TypeError instead of AbortError; original host children and exact recovered journal were retained.

installedQualification.newCases: Local, durable shared V1 and durable shared V2 Link forms in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit: URL-only and target-only patch, one Undo group, foreign work, exact page reload and future history.
installedQualification.policy: Original three-engine configuration, workers 1, zero retries, 60-second cases and 300-second process deadlines. No ignored failure, changed assertion or relaxed timeout.

observedWebkitCancellationFailure.cause: Unknown. The first failure retained only the TypeError name. Do not infer a cancellation bug, numeric-domain failure or Rust defect from that name.
observedWebkitCancellationFailure.diagnostics: The same assertion now retains non-AbortError message/stack/cause, abortCalls/aborted state, round and throwIfAborted availability. Default execution remains one round; opt-in BREDITOR_CANCEL_ROUNDS is bounded to 1..100.
observedWebkitCancellationFailure.conclusion: These repetitions did not reproduce the original failure and do not prove it repaired. It remains distinct from older unconfirmed observations until its actual cause is established.
